task.title: See a family tree
task.shortdesc: Draw the parents, partners and children of one person.

prereq.p: Open a person first. shows how.

stepresult.p: A drawing opens, with the person you chose in a box with a dark edge. Their parents are above. Their partners are beside them. Their children are below.

step.cmd: Choose the round mark between two partners.

info.p: Choose the marriage to open the page for that family. Choose a child to see the tree of that child.

stepresult.p: The mark shows the year of their marriage. A list opens with the marriage and each child.

step.cmd: Choose any box in the drawing to see the tree of that person.
Use the plus and minus buttons to show more or fewer generations.

info.p: The first pair is for parents and older people. The second pair is for children and younger people.

result.p: Choose to go back to the first person. Choose to see the whole drawing at once. A button such as +5 siblings means more brothers and sisters are not drawn. A big family may go past the edge of the screen.

postreq.p: The same tree is the pedigree in older manuals.
